name: Glass Bar
author: Trevor
description: Turns the bar into a liquid-glass rod: a copy of the wallpaper behind the bar is bent at the rim and lit along the edge.

barWidget.description: Invisible widget that paints refracting glass behind the whole bar.

schema.label: Liquid Glass
schema.description: Paint refracting glass behind the bar. Off leaves the bar's normal background.

schema.label: Bold bar text
schema.description: Makes labels on the bar and in its drop-downs bold so they stand out against the glass. Turning it off takes effect after a shell restart.

schema.label: Dark tint
schema.description: Darkens the glass so bar text stays readable over a bright wallpaper.
